messages.subject: Draft Particulars of Claim for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Henry,

Draft Particulars of Claim attached for review before we issue. Please check the factual paragraphs (contract dates, batch numbers, delivery quantities) and the schedule of loss figures, which total £2,418,640.

One point for Henry: we want to plead Brian Tovey's 26 February email confirming the bearing met ES-4471 - can you confirm you still have it? It strengthens the incorporation argument considerably.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
